about: AgentGlim first-run tour. One step per UI area, keyed by a stable CSS selector. A step whose target is missing or hidden is skipped. Edit with the walkthrough-update skill.

steps.title: Welcome to AgentGlim
steps.body: This page watches every agent, plan and dollar in one place. The dot by the logo shows the SuperAgent's watchers: green when the queue watcher and the 30-minute check are both running, amber when one is off, red when both are off or the page lost the server. Hover it to see which.

steps.title: Skill Editor
steps.body: This teal header button is the Skill Editor: it opens in a new tab and shows every skill on this machine on one map, where you can read and edit its files. Your skill folders stay on this machine; the editor is served by AgentGlim itself on /skills. It is no longer part of the Pages menu.

steps.title: Pages menu
steps.body: Opens the other pages: the Goals app, Model icons, Routing, Harness, Control, the handoff review and the reaper. The Goals app opens in a new tab and shows alignment, asks by goal, the weekly review, the operating rules and Print to PDF.

steps.title: Goals app
steps.body: The aligned chip opens the Goals app at /goals. It reads goals.json, goal-map.json and the reviews as JSON, groups open asks by goal, shows the weekly review and the operating rules, and prints to PDF. Demo data is at /goals?demo=1; the old built page redirects to the app.

steps.title: Setup
steps.body: Pick the harnesses you use (Claude Code, Codex, Pi, OpenCode), the plans you pay for, free API keys, a local model, notifications and custom projects. Cards for tools you turn off are hidden. Each section shows what AgentGlim found on this machine; key values are never shown.

steps.title: Plan limits
steps.body: One card per subscription. The bars show how much of each 5 hour and weekly limit is used, and when it resets.

steps.title: Budget routing
steps.body: Shows where new work gets sent and why. Click the title to fold it, or Compact to hide the notes.

steps.title: Approvals
steps.body: Everything waiting on you across plans. Pick your answers, then send them to the SuperAgent. Click the title to fold the list.

steps.title: New models to review
steps.body: Shows up when a new model or a changed price turns up. Approve the automatic label, edit it first, or keep the current price.

steps.title: Date and provider filters
steps.body: Pick Today, 7 days, 30 days, All or a custom range. The provider chips hide or show a provider in every card below.

steps.title: Headline numbers
steps.body: Active agents, tokens used, projects done, and how much work ran free or on the local model.

steps.title: Cost layers
steps.body: Paid, Free and Subscription rows split spend by how you pay. Free and local usage is priced at DS4.1 Flash rates so you can see what it saved.

steps.title: ElevenLabs
steps.body: Voice, sound effects and music spend. Shows whether a key is set, credits used and left on your plan (checked at most every 10 minutes), and what tools/eleven.mjs calls cost at your plan rate. Owner sessions only: plan runs never use this key.

steps.title: Local model
steps.body: What the local model saved. The menu here switches which local model is used.

steps.title: Free API savings
steps.body: Work sent to free API endpoints: OpenCode, OpenRouter free models, Groq, Cloudflare Workers AI and Google AI Studio. It costs $0, so the card shows what the same tokens would have cost at DS4.1 Flash rates.

steps.title: Jev routing
steps.body: Open Setup → Jev routing to add JEV_API_KEY from typesafe.ai, check the active routes file and test a model pick. Turn routing off to use Sonnet for subagents. The Routing page shows the routing decisions.

steps.title: Subscriptions
steps.body: Monthly subscriptions: OpenCode Go, Codex and Claude, each with its flat price. Each card compares the tokens used with what the same usage would cost at direct API prices, an estimate, so you can see if the plan pays off.

steps.title: Usage chart
steps.body: Spend or tokens every 10 minutes, by billing class. It opens on Spend as a heat grid; the buttons switch the metric and the chart style, and your pick is remembered. Hover for details.

steps.title: Providers
steps.body: Top providers for the chosen range, with the card title. Scroll inside the list for the rest.

steps.title: Cache and token mix
steps.body: Per provider and class: tokens read fresh, from cache and written to cache, with what that costs at list rates.

steps.title: Foldable sections
steps.body: Click any section title like this one to fold it. Compact keeps the section open but shorter. The page remembers your choice.

steps.title: Containers
steps.body: The AgentGlim container fleet: each agentbox container, whether it is running, and its details. View only, nothing here changes a container.

steps.title: Goals
steps.body: How well the week's agent time matches the owner's goals. Rings show alignment per goal, the bars show where agent minutes went against each goal's weight, the line shows drift week over week, and the ladder lists next week's priorities. Data comes from the weekly goals review.

steps.title: Status
steps.body: The SuperAgent's latest verdict, run modes and trials. Refresh now asks the SuperAgent for a fresh check.

steps.title: Status verdict
steps.body: One line from the SuperAgent on how the harness is doing right now.

steps.title: Status tiles
steps.body: Counts of plans running, waiting on your audit, waiting for a slot, done today, held and done overall. The small bars on the right are the Claude and Codex 5 hour and weekly usage.

steps.title: Run modes
steps.body: Day or overnight harness mode, the hang reaper switch, and per harness (Claude, Codex, OpenCode Go) the mode, speed, final audit model, cloud and API switches and usage gates. Clicks queue a request the watcher applies.

steps.title: Watch out
steps.body: Warnings worth a look: paused verifiers, rate limits, queues, hung readers, RAM and temporary storage. In depth opens the full warnings view; hide folds it.

steps.title: Hang reaper
steps.body: The AI verdicts on stuck processes from the last 24 hours: how many were checked, killed or kept. In depth opens the Reaper page.

steps.title: The SuperAgent said
steps.body: The SuperAgent's last status answer: what is done, running, blocked and next, with when it was written.

steps.title: For you
steps.body: Your open items, ranked by how much clearing each one unblocks, at most two per plan. Show more widens the list; in depth explains each score.

steps.title: Trials
steps.body: Running trials, such as premium effort or orchestrator briefs: how many runs are done and how they compare with the baseline. In depth opens the trial page.

steps.title: Optimize runs
steps.body: Counts of run problems by kind (handoffs, time, tokens, quality) and the top fixes. Fixes, in depth lists every one with its evidence.

steps.title: Finished in 24 hours
steps.body: Plans that finished in the last day, with their verify estimate and how long ago.

steps.title: Status charts
steps.body: Audit % per round, working cost and tokens per area of plans. Switch between separate plans and combined by area; split breaks one area out.

steps.title: Plan table
steps.body: Every plan with its state, audit %, time and latest note. Click the icon of a row to copy its status for a chat.

steps.title: Status buttons
steps.body: Compact keeps only the verdict and tiles, charts and table show or hide those parts, and refresh now asks the SuperAgent for a fresh check.

steps.title: Status menu
steps.body: Switch between the overview and a single plan. The buttons beside it toggle compact view, charts and the plan table.

steps.title: Active builds
steps.body: Plans in a build round right now. Each one goes through one build round, then your audit, then the final verifier. Plan 68 is AgentGlim itself, so its round and audit verdict sit on a line under the AgentGlim row. The SuperAgent row shows the SuperAgent session's helper agents. The next steps walk through one row piece by piece.

steps.title: Pipeline
steps.body: Every plan and the stage it is at. Hover a cell for details. The pause button holds a plan so nothing new starts; a play button means it is on hold, click it to resume. Rows that are not real plans are left out.

steps.title: Priority picker
steps.body: This P1, P2 or P3 button sits on each pipeline row. Click it and pick a tier to change how soon that plan is built. A dash means no priority is set yet.

steps.title: Pipeline filters
steps.body: These chips filter the pipeline. Pick categories, states or priority tiers (P1, P2, P3). Click a chip again to clear it.

steps.title: Pause a whole category
steps.body: The Pause categories button at the right end of the key opens a small list of the categories, each with its state and a Pause or Resume button. Pause asks first and names the plans, then puts a HOLD on every plan in that category that has none, so nothing new starts there; a running step finishes first. Plans that already had a HOLD keep it. While any category is paused the button shows a Paused count, and a line below the key says since when, how many plans it holds and how many owner HOLDs it kept; its rows show a paused tag. Resume lifts only the category's own HOLDs.

steps.title: A project row
steps.body: One row per plan: the copy icon, the hold button, its priority, version, open item count and links. The dots to the right show which stage it is at.

steps.title: Sub-features line
steps.body: Every project row has up to three folding sections: Sub-features (its feature list and how many are done), Merged projects (plans merged into it or pinned to its repo) and Sub-tasks. Click a line to open or close it; finished ones fold away.

steps.title: Sub-tasks
steps.body: Every agent the SuperAgent sent for this project: Agent-tool subagents, agent.sh runs and queue takes. Running ones sit on top with their model icon; done ones fold behind "N done, hidden (show)".

steps.title: Open items count
steps.body: How many open items wait on you for this plan. Click it to jump to the Approvals card filtered to that plan.

steps.title: Plan page link
steps.body: Opens the plan's own review page in a new tab.

steps.title: Approvals page link
steps.body: Opens the plan's Approvals and next steps page, every decision and item for that plan.

steps.title: Running tasks
steps.body: Tracked jobs from every harness (Claude Code, Codex, Pi, OpenCode), nested under their plan. Each chip shows the task, its state and its result; the line above opens or closes the list.

steps.title: Merged projects
steps.body: Whole projects folded into one row, for example AIViz inside plan 03. Click the line to show or hide them.

steps.title: Other projects
steps.body: Projects outside the plans harness, with any agents working in them right now.

steps.title: Driver events
steps.body: The latest events from the build driver, newest at the top.

steps.title: Custom projects
steps.body: Your own projects, added on the Setup page: pick a folder or a data file and what to show (counts, progress, last run). Built-in ones, like a leads campaign or an email sequence, keep their own tables. Use + Add to add one.

steps.title: That's the tour
steps.body: Click this ? button any time to see it again. Arrow keys move between steps and Esc closes the tour.
